BWA.note: Training is for the public, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The article says the government has launched the SmartBots Village Connectivity Project, which is bringing internet access to over 500 communities across Botswana; no connected count is stated.

ITWeb Africa reports a BOCRA-funded four-month eBotho Digital Literacy Roadshow, run by the NGO Cybersmart Botswana with the National Library Service and the communications ministry, launched in November 2023 to teach digital skills to the public at libraries nationwide; no number trained is stated.
